source_caption_text:
Drake pulled up to Ye’s Houston show, in a move that was not on anyone's 2026 bingo card.

On Oct. 31, Yeezy performed a sold-out show at Reliant Stadium. Featuring performances from Playboi Carti and North West, the concert reportedly set a new U.S. stadium rap concert attendance record, with 80,210 attendees. One person who checked out the show was Drake. Several videos were captured of Drake watching the concert with Travis Scott. Ye even addressed Drizzy at one point during the show.

"They caught you coming in late, Drake," Ye said.

Earlier that night, Drake and Travis were spotted sitting courtside at the Houston Rockets vs. Oklahoma City Thunder game. 

Drake and Ye have had a complicated relationship that has gone from admiration to animosity over the years. Recently, Ye has been seemingly trying to make amends. Last March, he said he loved Drake and later tried to get Aubrey on his "Preacher Man" track off Bully. Last month, Drake liked a post on Instagram showing Ye unveiling a street sign in honor of his mother.
